target: ODF1.2 specification functionality baseline plus CUPS printing
priority: Stage active; Words paused and columns preserved; further Sheets catalogue work waits
completion_rule: Each feature requires relevant read/render/edit/save/reopen, semantic or visual oracle, and CUPS evidence where meaningful. Schema validity, byte retention, signature recognition and upstream name counts are separate evidence and cannot close a functional requirement.
version_policy: Default new native documents to1.2; preserve newer source versions. Explicit optional operations needing newer syntax retain their established version upgrade behavior. Missing manifest versions are repaired to1.2 in serialized exports while exact edit-source manifest bytes remain available to history.
coverage_note: Initial area inventory; decompose into normative element/attribute/behavior requirements before a full conformance/completion claim.

areas.evidence: ZIP/package preservation and archive-part undo exist; plain-package and manifest gates added. Detached bounded memory package loading/serialization preserves source/history/image identities. Shared file/memory readers force EOF/CRC validation, with permanent empty/nonempty CRC regressions and an independent malformed-ZIP corpus.
areas.remaining: Encrypted packages, signature verification/writing, RDF/package metadata semantics, flat XML and broader package cases remain.

areas.evidence: New native ODT/ODS/ODP use1.2;1.3/1.4 source versions retained by editing tests.
areas.remaining: Template and additional ODF document kinds, explicit export-version policy and full consumer/producer implementation-defined documentation remain.

areas.evidence: Native paragraphs/runs/styles, shaping/bidi, lists, tabs and editing/history; Stage scoped character/paragraph formatting, transient typing and exact replacement ranges. Shared reader scope checks isolate surrounding fonts/defaults/pages/header geometry and image-list budgets from inline embedded ODF declarations; opaque object text is retained and diagnosed rather than flattened. Known selected-object paragraph/frame/table/cell contexts and finite source tab advances now participate in actual guarded paste. Empty frames and nested/repeated/empty cells have independent selected model/XML/raster/CUPS evidence. Embedded document rendering and complete unknown/default/list/field inheritance remain unsupported or incomplete.
areas.remaining: Complete text/frame/anchor layout, section/column flow, vertical/ruby/embedded/color fonts and broader editing behavior remain.

areas.evidence: Words page number/count fields in page stories work.
areas.remaining: General variables/references/notes, generated indexes/TOC, tracked changes and field editing/layout remain.

areas.evidence: Words structural tables/merged/nested cells and sizing; Stage table rendering; Sheets native cells/arrays/references. Stage empty-cell-only tables now render in native Wayland GPU and PDF/CUPS; independent before/after pixel and cell-paint cases verify the fix.
areas.remaining: Full styles/borders/number formats, structural formula rewrites, table editing in Stage, and spreadsheet range/merge/row/column tools remain.

areas.evidence: OpenFormula-specific signature census finds312/392 available and80 missing; existing numerical/type/reference corpora provide function-specific evidence.
areas.remaining: All required function semantics, operators/reference intersections/3D, settings, named-expression/locale behavior and explicit evaluator-group conformance remain.

areas.evidence: Native Stage provides shapes, affine transforms, paths, masters, embedded images/text, direct object gestures, scoped stacking/grouping and selection-aware source/archive history. Layers have document/page/master scopes, screen/print visibility, protection and scoped authoring. Scoped solid/no fill and stroke, independent image/fill/stroke opacity, winding rules, and caps/joins have selected independent model/XML/native Wayland/raster/CUPS evidence. The installed7b14ea0 runtime includes caps/joins and the verified object clipboard. Committed clipboard source7b14ea0 adds selected-object/private/public ODP and Unicode representations, guarded cut/paste transactions, source-context/style/default/font/layer/media isolation, repeated/empty-cell handling and actual keyboard/universal-menu commands. Current dash source consumes common named two-sequence patterns with independent width-relative measures and ordered alpha overlays; scoped authoring, exact source/archive history, mixed-selection controls and clipboard list dependency/remapping have independent selected model, Release/sanitizer Wayland, schema and CUPS checks. The new geometry corpus has378 Cairo/analytic cases alongside756 solid-stroke cases. Per-build and staged evidence is separate from a completed installation receipt. These selected cases do not establish complete source-context/reference isolation or whole-format rendering/editing. Marker source now reads/renders common resources with original endpoint tangents, independent absolute widths and corrected OASIS placement. Scoped endpoint authoring, marker-aware hit geometry, shaft trimming with dash-phase retention, union alpha and clipboard resource remapping have selected independent model/source/history, real Wayland Release/sanitizer, official-schema/package and CUPS evidence. Build/stage/installed receipts remain separate gates. Connector scene source now resolves file-scoped forward/hidden/group/enhanced targets, preserves supplied curves and computes all four route modes under documented native policies. Selected analytic scene, native Wayland Release/sanitizer movement/history/pixel and actual CUPS/reopen checks provide source-checkpoint evidence; live endpoint/cache export editing and dedicated authoring remain unfinished. Current installed runtime7b14ea0 has verified clipboard support; pending dash/marker installations are tracked separately. Connector dependent geometry source now updates affected modes, group/transitive targets and SVG/endpoint caches in the same geometry transaction. Source/archive undo, protected/invalid rollback, exact pointer-return behavior, independent affine SVG/CairoSVG comparisons and selected native Wayland/CUPS edit corpora provide incremental evidence. Dedicated creation/reconnection/routing tools and whole-consumer/ODF coverage remain unfinished.
areas.remaining: Broader layer/reference interoperability and source edge cases beyond the selected corpus; broader fixed-label/navigation rewrites; full group styles/metadata/anchor/event/glue-point and identity-reference rewrites; broader object clipboard source/context/reference semantics; complete connectors, custom geometry, advanced fills/strokes, charts/3D/OLE/embedded content, Word anchors and authoring tools remain. Deprecated middle joins and vendor miter limits remain diagnosed; exhaustive marker/junction and dashed-curve/cap-shape interoperability and broader paint fidelity remain open.
